errors.text: The proposed intervention omits the key 4.2 at.% Cr addition and instead assumes that thermomechanical processing can produce coherent B2 nanoprecipitates in Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr without direct evidence that this phase is stable in that system.

The density criterion is framed relative to W-based RHEAs rather than demonstrating a reduction from the 10.44 g/cm³ HfMoTaTiZr baseline; aging or precipitation alone cannot materially reduce density without a defined compositional change.

The baseline is mischaracterized as having less than 5% room-temperature ductility or a continuous B2 matrix, whereas the target baseline is an as-cast single-phase BCC alloy with approximately 11.6% compressive fracture strain.
The proposed tensile metrics are not directly comparable with the target's room-temperature compression measurements.
